neighbours.label: ' latest' (also newer/recent) in 'get/check the latest news/features' promo phrasing
fire: Subscribe to our newsletter today and get the latest news and updates on upcoming sales and events.
Please check the latest job vacancy details posted below before you submit your application form.
Stay tuned with our channel to watch the latest video lectures for physics and chemistry.
This exam package has many latest features that will be very helpful for your preparation.
Visit our blog to read the latest tech insights written by our engineering team every week.
Our store now offers the latest models of phones at prices that everyone can afford.
Follow the page closely to learn the latest results from the school board election.
Join the mailing list and receive the latest offers directly in your inbox each morning.
quiet: Our newsletter arrives weekly with stories about upcoming sales and community events.
Job vacancy details are posted below, so read them before you submit your application form.
Video lectures for physics and chemistry are available on our channel for every student.
The old exam package has many features that were helpful during my preparation last year.
He arrived late to the meeting because the train was delayed by nearly an hour.
A phone store nearby sells devices at prices that everyone can afford during the winter.
The final results from the school board election were announced by the mayor yesterday.
By joining the mailing list you will get a discount coupon in your inbox.

notes: Label and sentences written by Claude Sonnet subagents (8 poles each) from the card text alone (prompt: haiku_labeler/prompt_l5.md); one retry on mechanical checks. Part of a 192-pole layer-5 sweep.
